reviews.title: Unexpectedly, solo use helped my AuDHD brain become productive!
reviews.text:
I use this solo and can’t believe how much it works for my productivity! I’m being vulnerable in case another neurodivergent person can feel validated from this: I went from brushing about once every other day to brushing my teeth and flossing twice every day for several weeks!! You have no idea how huge that is for me. This is the habit I previously most struggled with as an AuDHD person!

I grew up struggling with authority because it felt like my autonomy was threatened when an adult told me what to do. On the other hand, if I would try to set goals for myself, I would end up failing because my own deadlines didn’t mean much. But when I set up all the goals, rules, rewards, and punishments as my own “master” it’s like it solved both problems. I’m not being too lenient with myself because the rules are clear and the possible outcomes are set out. I genuinely rush to get things done by the deadline just like I used to for school assignments. 

This app helped me realize that I’ve inadvertently done a similar setup to achieve past goals. Even if this app isn’t always available in my lifetime I’m honestly so grateful for what I learned from it. I feel like I uncovered a formula. This is what people meant when they talked about self discipline.

I only downloaded this app because it seemed exciting. It’s like I got rewarded with completed goals for just chasing a high.

reviews.title: I don’t buy subscriptionware…
reviews.text:
I don’t buy subscriptionware in which we are called upon to pay over and over again for something we used to pay for once—often amounting to hundreds of dollars over time. No, I prefer to pay once, as it should be. There needs to be a “pay once” option, even if the developers (and more importantly, their greedy investors) would rather resist this idea.

Later…

But, my partner really, really wanted me to buy in. So I have. I’d like to give 5 stars, but I can’t. Too many bugs and missing features. For example, there are tasks I’ve set up properly that my partner for some reason cannot check off. Also: cycling daily and weekly tasks have to be assigned a particular time or a particular day, when setting them up. (At least the app is working that way for me.) But for some daily tasks I simply want an “any time in the day” option.

Still later…

The app is more unfinished than finished. There are many ways it could not work for us. For some reason my sub could not successfully check off completed tasks. Thinking it was user error, I searched for effective troubleshooting documentation but found nothing useful. Particularly irksome was that I was forced to tie daily tasks to specific times of the day, instead of being able to simply set up a checklist of daily tasks that don’t need a time associated with their daily accomplishment as long as they are done within the day.

I’ve since cancelled my annual subscription with less than a month of use, even at the loss of $30.

The app does not work for us.

reviews.title: Lots of issues with my account and with my subscription.
reviews.text:
I tried using this app because I saw a review for it. I bought premium because I wanted the extra features, but I soon started having issues on my account, and was unable to log in on the account I had bought premium on. 

Customer service was unable to help me access my account, and was unable to refund me. Because I still had a partner who was using premium, I made a new account and bought premium again (since both partners need to have premium in order for it to work).  This was a mistake. 

I eventually stopped using the app and cancelled my subscription through Apple. Unfortunately, that didn't seem to cancel the subscription on the app's end, as I just had a surprise charge for an app I haven't used in a year, and didn't even have installed on my phone. And I have no way to  dispute the claim and get a refund because it was supposedly cancelled by apple. 

It's honestly too much of a hassle for me to want to use this app again, even in the future. It's very frustrating to keep coming up against situations where I have issues with the subscription without the ability to get a refund, especially since I am living in a situation now where every dollar matters to me. The subscription managed to swallow up $90 dollars, and I only used it for 6 months. 

Two stars, only because the app itself is actually functional, even though all the features are pretty basic.
